text:
monitoring-bot: CRITICAL: 502s from pagerbridge inbound webhook for service=svc-inference-runtime — no pages were emitted to oncall window :rotating_light:
maya: saw the alert, not seeing any pager activity in the logs. are pages queued?
ryan: looks like pagerbridge returned 502 on our webhook -> incidentbot aborted. log tail:
```
2026-03-16T22:10:12Z ERROR webhook handler: upstream 502 {request_id=ab12, headers={x-signature=, content-type=application/json}}
```
sam: weird, x-signature is empty in that log. did the signing proxy change headers? :thinking_face:
ops-bot: automated fallback didn't trigger because only 1 failed attempt, and threshold is 3 in ->alert_policy. it didn't escalate.
oncall-sre: I can confirm i didn't get an SMS or call for the alert. manual page would help.
maya: manual page sent to oncall now — pls acknowledge when you get it @oncall-sre :phone:
oncall-sre: got it, acked.
ryan: quick mitigation plan:
- requeue pending webhooks -> `./scripts/requeue-webhooks --service svc-inference-runtime`
- increase immediate fallback threshold to 1 for 10m (temp) -> `kubectl patch cm alert-config -p '{"data":{"fallback_threshold":"1"}}'`
- restart pagerbridge pod to pick up header fix -> `kubectl rollout restart deploy/pagerbridge`
sam: patch ready, small change in signing-proxy: it was renaming `x-signature` to `x-sig` on error path. deploying fix now.
ops-bot: requeue done (job 9842). 12 webhooks retried, 11 successful, 1 still 502.
ryan: restarted pagerbridge, rolling back old signer header transform.
maya: minute-by-minute: please watch alerts and confirm no more missing pages. set pager duty escalation to manual for 30m if anything flaps.
oncall-sre: still seeing one residual 502 for req ab99, requeued manually and page delivered.
maya: temporary triage notes: owner=ryan, follow-up postmortem and config change to allow 1-fail fallback until signing-proxy rollouts validated. add runbook step for manual requeue.
ryan: will open postmortem and cherry-pick fix to staging then prod. ETA PR in 45m. any customer impact?
oncall-sre: no customer-facing incidents reported yet, only internal paging missed. we'll update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
maya: thank you all. adding postmortem tag and assigning ops rotation for 48h observation. :eyes:
